title: Surreal Mask of Dreams
description: A large ornate theatrical mask floats in a cloudy, twilight sky. The mask features a white face with colorful branch-like patterns around the eyes, a hummingbird with a glowing green orb on the forehead, film reels, film projectors casting beams of light, and small silhouetted figures engaged in various activities across its surface.
